channel.title: Aryeh Leib Toren — Writing
channel.description: Featured essays by Aryeh Leib Thorne Toren.

item.title: Kislev as the Architecture of Completion
item.description: Light, bitachon, the lights added night by night, and the reading of the Nesi'im: how Kislev turns potential into actual and darkness into light.

item.title: Seven Days, Twenty-Eight Days, and the Number 61: The Road from the Ballot to a Government
item.description: The ballots have been counted. The next part of Israeli democracy happens in quiet rooms rather than at voting stations.

item.title: Nothing Has Happened Yet
item.description: Two notes from Rashi on Toldot, five verses apart: the quiet stretch made Yitzchak careless, the hard year made him work. Guard anyway, plant anyway.

item.title: The Life That Continues: Sarah’s Particular Dominion, the Name of the Parsha, and Covenantal Non-Domination
item.description: Why is a parsha that opens with Sarah's death called the life of Sarah? Likkutei Sichos 15, Chayei Sarah A: true life is enduring influence, and Sarah's serarah guards the inheritance. With Pettit, Skinner, Nelson and Elazar.

item.title: Clear Title as Covenantal Acquisition: Rambam’s Hilchot Zechiyah uMattanah, Chapters 4–6 (3 November 2026 / 23 Cheshvan 5787), and the Demand for Public, Intent-Aligned Ownership in Torah and Republican Thought
item.description: The daily Rambam for 3 November 2026, Hilchot Zechiyah uMattanah 4 to 6: a transfer holds when it is final, public and aligned with true intent. Read beside Machpelah, Locke, Pettit, Demsetz and North.

item.title: Buying the Cave in Public: Witnessed Legitimacy, Continuity after the Akeidah, and the Covenantal Republic in the Week of Chayei Sarah
item.description: Avraham refused the cave as a gift and paid full price before witnesses at the city gate. Chayei Sarah read beside the public certification of the 26th Knesset results, with Rashi, Ramban, the Rebbe, Elazar, Nelson and Pettit.

item.title: The 3.25% Line: What 27 October 2026 Taught Israel
item.description: About one valid vote in eighteen on 27 October 2026 went to a list that will hold no seat. The 3.25 percent threshold read as hishtadlut, ordinary honest effort, with the Rambam, Pettit and Elazar.

item.title: Context as Covenant: The Discipline of Model Windows, Bot Transcripts, and the Preservation of Human Ameilut
item.description: Bigger context windows do not remove the limits. Keep durable rules outside the transcript, scope each exchange, and leave the reconstructing, verifying and deciding to the human: ameilut preserved.

item.title: Knowing That One Must Circumcise Oneself: The Vayeira Sicha, Self-Mastery, and the Dual Service of Covenant in Orthodox Theology and Republican Thought
item.description: The sicha of 20 Marcheshvan 5713 on Parshat Vayeira, building on the earlier transmission of the Rebbe Rayatz from 20 Marcheshvan 5693, places before every Jew a dual demand.

item.title: Hasbara Grifters, Conditional Support, Alliances for “Change,” Aggressive Confrontation, and the Real Interests of the Jews of Israel: A Covenantal-Republican Critique
item.description: The real interests of the Jews of Israel are not a more favorable ranking in foreign public-opinion surveys, a higher volume of approving clips, or a more skillful explanation of Israeli actions to audiences that have already decided the question.

item.title: Every Faction, One Clock
item.description: The voting ended Tuesday night at 22:00.

item.title: A Morsel of Bread
item.description: We have just come through a season of words.

item.title: The Government That Stays
item.description: The ballots are in, the posters are coming down, and the talks have barely started.

item.title: After Which Things? Four Readings of One Phrase
item.description: The Akeida, read on Shabbat 31 October 2026, opens with four words that have kept commentators busy for a thousand years: "וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה".

item.title: The Treaty Before the Test
item.description: On Friday 30 October 2026 the sixth aliyah of Vayera closes at Be'er Sheva.

item.title: Here I Am: The Akeida and the Families of Israel
item.description: On Shabbat, 31 October 2026, we read the Akeida.

item.title: A Well, Seven Ewes and a Tamarisk
item.description: The sixth aliyah of Vayera, read on Friday 30 October 2026, is a short scene of diplomacy.

item.title: From Notebooks to Ballots: Mediation, Simplest Interpretations, and National-Religious Political Behavior
item.description: An analysis of the multi-layered mediation from Rav Kook’s private notebooks to contemporary electoral practice.

item.title: Pray for Avimelech
item.description: The day after the vote, Avraham prays for the king who wronged him and asks for the very blessing his own house still lacks.

item.title: One in Nine Isn't Here
item.description: Why Israel's official turnout reads lower than the share of residents who vote. Tuesday 27 October 2026 / 16 Cheshvan 5787.
